description: Final acceptance inputs authored after freezing the semantic rubric and concentration thresholds. Do not tune policy or rubric against these inputs.

cases.text: Plan a seven-day vacation in Portugal for two adults and a teenager. Compare Lisbon and Porto, account for train travel, a nut allergy, a tight daily budget and museum opening hours, then give us a realistic itinerary.
Add these two household expenses: thirty dollars for gas and fifteen dollars for groceries. Give only the total expense.
Quick factual question: what is the capital city of Italy?
How many seconds are there in one minute?

Research solar panels versus a small wind turbine for a rural household. Compare seasonal output, installation and maintenance costs, permitting assumptions and the reliability of the evidence before recommending one.

Produce an exhaustive technical report on a replicated distributed ledger. Prove its safety and liveness invariants under Byzantine behavior, partitions and crash recovery, analyze combinations of failure modes, and synthesize competing protocol designs into a justified architecture.
Make a simple two-button meme. The buttons say fix the bug and add another feature, and the sweating person is me.
Open TextEdit on my Mac, please.
Could you sort that out for me when you get a chance?
Tell me an original fantasy story about a dragon who collects umbrellas.

bots.name: Trip Planner
bots.description: Plans vacations and travel: destinations, itineraries, flights, hotels, packing and accessibility.

bots.name: Budget Planner
bots.description: Builds household or group budgets, calculates expenses and fair cost splits, compares financial scenarios.

bots.name: Research & Reports
bots.description: Finds reliable factual answers, researches technical and scientific questions, compares evidence and writes reports.

bots.name: Mac Operator
bots.description: Operates websites and authorized Mac apps: opens apps, navigates screens, edits visible forms and verifies actions.

bots.name: Meme Lord
bots.description: Creates funny memes from image templates or user-supplied images and caption text.
